description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

You never want to depend on the ground beneath your roots, but in desperate times it can be your most reliable ally. Your roots reach deep into the ground and draw enough life-giving nutrients to give you one last chance. You are not knocked out and regain Hit Points equal to 6d8 plus half your level. Your wounded condition still increases by 1 as though you had been dying and recovered. You cannot move until you take an Interact action to draw your roots back to the surface.
